item.title: Cosmos EVM Vulnerability Triggers Attacks Across Three Networks
item.summary: A vulnerability in the shared Cosmos EVM software has triggered attacks on three blockchain networks, prompting Cosmos Labs to urge affected projects to stop producing blocks and apply security updates. The incident highlights the risks associated with widely reused infrastructure, where a weakness in a common software component can expose multiple independent networks to the […] The post Cosmos EVM Vulnerability Triggers Attacks Across Three Networks appeared first on CoinTrust .
